title: Gentle AI read-only review candidate risk assessment

consumed.description: True when this exact candidate identity's terminal review authority was already acknowledged (reviewtransaction.CompactTargetConsumed), the same evidence review status itself consults before offering a fresh START for the identical identity.

review_due.description: Whether an orchestrator should run the review preflight now. False when the candidate is consumed or passive, or when it is medium risk under the changed_lines slice budget; true for high risk, or for medium risk at or over reviewtransaction.LargeChangeLines (400) changed_lines. changed_lines is whatever range the caller assessed: run with --base-ref <last reviewed boundary> --committed-only to make it the accumulated ODD slice.

review_due_reason.description: The exact rule that produced review_due, in evaluation order: already_reviewed (candidate consumed) beats high_risk, which beats slice_budget_reached, which beats under_budget and passive.

next_transition.description: The exact, literally runnable `review status ... --next-transition` preflight continuation. Present only when review_due is true.
